name: Day / Night Cycle
summary: A clock that turns into pressure: phases, a darkness that follows the player, and a curve other scripts can read.
description: Runs a day as a fraction from 0 to 1, announces phase changes once each, and dims the world through a tinted overlay pinned to the player -- which is how a script covers the view at all when the scripting contract exposes no viewport. Everything else reads getDarkness() and getDayNumber() and decides for itself what night means: more enemies, faster ones, colder, hungrier.
nextSteps: Put DayNightCycle.js on a manager actor and tag it Clock.
Set followTag to whatever the overlay should stay centred on, usually Player.
Read getDarkness() and getDayNumber() from your spawner to make night mean something.
